_meta.description: Single source of truth for Bland.ai pathway, tool, knowledge-base, voice, and webhook IDs used by Sales Enablement. Loaded at runtime by Python scripts in this folder and cross-checked by a Vitest test against superpatch-frontend/src/lib/config/pathways.ts and superpatch-frontend/supabase/functions/_shared/pathways.ts.
_meta.update_procedure: When a pathway, tool, KB, or voice ID changes: (1) edit this file, (2) bump _meta.updated_at, (3) update the TS mirrors if the key list changed, (4) run pnpm test from superpatch-frontend/ to verify cross-check.
